title: Hoshaya bar Zavda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Taanit 26b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.26b.16), [challenging the words of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.26b.17); Rabbi Yitzchak resolves his difficulty.[^1]

notes.text: The Gemara gives Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s explanation in bar Kappara’s name. It attributes the objection to Rabbi Zeira’s father, or alternatively to Hoshaya bar Zavda. Rabbi Yitzchak answers it. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=286&lang=en) cites Hoshaya as the objector.
